title: firework cupcake toppers
text: firework cupcake toppers. These are sooo cool!  They come with little tubes over the "firework" and are easy to apply to cupcakes or any other item you'd like to decorate.  Mylar like multicolor fireworks - really pretty.  The tubes over the firework keeps them from getting folded or funky.  Stick and decor stands about 5 or 6".  Love it.
